show.description:
A wealthy heir, rebelling against his family’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity and lives as a cleaning staff member. Meanwhile, an orphaned bride, abandoned at the altar, makes an impulsive decision to marry a stranger.

What begins as a marriage of convenience slowly turns into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and emotional scars proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places.
